text:
rafa-peopleops: quick heads up 12 interviews created via the ATS bulk export this morning show an empty rubric in the scheduler UI. interviewers are getting invites but the scoring section is blank.

harper-recruit: do we know which flow created them (bulk vs manual)?

rafa-peopleops: bulk export -> bulk-schedule job. looks consistent for roles tagged backend/swe.

devin-eng: sample payload from the bulk job shows `rubric_id` present, but our mapper expects `score_template`. suspect mapping lambda rename.

rafa-peopleops: sample (sanitized):
```
interview_id=I-2044 candidate=C-442 role=backend rubic_id=tmpl-old-77 start=2026-05-12T14:00Z
```
(typo on our side in the sample 1 think actual key in export is `rubric_id`)

opsbot: [bulk-scheduler] 2026-05-12T11:02:12Z WARN missing_field key=score_template interview=I-2044

devin-eng: confirmed. a recent refactor renamed mapping keys but left an alias out. plan: revert mapping change and run a backfill that maps `rubric_id` -> `score_template` for interviews starting in next 48h. ETA 40m for revert + smoke.

maria-scheduler: impact: interviews still run normally, but structured feedback will be lost unless interviewers manually select a rubric. recruiters have started getting DMs from interviewers asking for guidance.

rafa-peopleops: could we add a temporary manual paragraph to invites with a link to the correct rubric while we patch? recruiters requested that so interviewers have something immediate.

harper-recruit: i'll add a one-line fallback to invite bodies: "If you don't see a rubric, please use: https://docs.redwood.com/rubrics/backend-ic-v2" Keep it candidate safe.

devin-eng: revert deployed to staging, running backfill dry-run: 12 rows to patch. backfill will call scheduler.assign_rubric(interview_id, template_id) and add audit tag `rubric-backfill-20260512`.

opsbot: [deploy-bot] 2026-05-12T11:35:00Z user=devin-eng env=prod change=revert->ats-mapping-lambda@v1.2.1

devin-eng: prod revert done. backfill ran, patched 12 interviews. left note on each: "rubric auto-assigned from ATS export; contact recruiting if incorrect."

maria-scheduler: spot-checked 5 invites, rubrics now visible. sending a short FYI to interviewers and recruiters.

rafa-peopleops: please add a short monitor for 7 days to detect >2 interviews/hour created without a rubric and an alert to #people-ops. also add a unit test asserting both `rubric_id` and `score_template` are accepted mapping keys.

devin-eng: will add monitor + test. logging retro item: tighten schema contract between ATS export and mapping lambda.

harper-recruit: thanks everyone thumbsup: closing the loop on this one.

rafa-peopleops: closing heart:"
